subject: microbiology
title: Cytokines, Interleukins, Interferons and Helper T Cell Subsets

steps.tx: **Cytokines** are soluble messengers acting autocrine, paracrine and endocrine, pleiotropic and redundant, in cascades where one induces others (TNF instructing IL 1 and IL 6), named interleukins when between leukocytes, chemokines when chemotactic, colony stimulating factors when marrow directed, and interferons when antiviral. Dose and context, not name alone, decide inflammation versus repair.
steps.say: One cytokine, many jobs; many cytokines, one job: context writes cytokine meaning.

left.title: Cytokine properties
points: Short half lives, local action mostly
Receptors signal via JAK STAT and NF kappa B roads

right.title: Families
points: CSFs: G, M, GM colony stimulating

steps.tx: **Th1 responses** (IL 12 and interferon gamma driven, T bet) arm macrophages against intracellular bacteria and viruses: Mycobacterium, Leishmania, Listeria live or die by this axis, whose defects (IL 12 and interferon gamma receptor) present as Mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial disease with BCG complications.
steps.say: Interferon gamma arms macrophages; its pathway defects let BCG become disease.

left.title: Th1 programme
points: Inducers: IL 12, IL 18 from dendritic cells

right.title: Th1 failure
points: MSMD: IL12 and IFN gamma axis defects
BCGosis in infants as presenting sign
Interferon gamma therapy in CGD kinship

steps.tx: **Th2 responses** (IL 4, 5, 13; GATA3) answer helminths and drive allergy: IgE switching, eosinophil recruitment and activation, mucus and smooth muscle programmes, with atopic diseases as their misdirection at harmless antigens. Helminths actively tutor this axis toward regulation to survive it.
steps.say: Th2 expels worms and, misdirected, wheezes at dust: same cytokines, two reputations.

left.title: Th2 programme
points: IL 4: IgE switch and Th2 instruction

right.title: Th2 therapeutics
points: Anti IL 5 and IL 5R in eosinophilic asthma
Helminth therapy trials invert the logic experimentally

steps.tx: **Th17 responses** (IL 17, IL 22; induced by IL 6, TGF beta and IL 23) defend mucosal fungi and extracellular bacteria by neutrophil recruitment and epithelial antimicrobials; defects cause chronic mucocutaneous candidiasis (STAT3, IL 17 pathway), excess drives psoriasis and spondyloarthritis whose biologics target IL 17 and IL 23.
steps.say: Th17 guards mucosae with neutrophils; too little invites Candida, too much inflames skin and joints.

left.title: Th17 programme
points: IL 17A and F: neutrophil chemotaxis factors

right.title: Th17 extremes
points: Excess: psoriasis, psoriatic and axial arthritis
Anti IL 17: Candida infections as on target cost
Anti IL 23 p19: psoriasis and bowel indications

steps.tx: **Regulatory T cells** (FoxP3, CD25 high, IL 10 and TGF beta instruments) police all helper programmes, their absence catastrophic (IPEX scurfy phenotype: autoimmunity, enteropathy, eczema in infancy). Checkpoint molecules (CTLA 4, PD 1 from the oncology lessons) are their surface cousins borrowed by tumours.
steps.say: No FoxP3 police, no tolerance: IPEX is regulation's absence written in infants.

right.title: Treg clinical
points: Low dose IL 2 trials expand Tregs

steps.tx: **Key interleukins** by examination pairing: IL 1 fever and inflammasomes (anakinra blocks), IL 2 T growth (aldesleukin cancer heritage, Treg dependence), IL 6 acute phase and arthritis (tocilizumab), IL 7 lymphopoiesis (receptor defects SCID), IL 10 suppression (EBV mimics it), IL 12 and 23 sharing p40 (ustekinumab target). Each drug in biologics clinics is a cytokine sentence interrupted.
steps.say: Learn cytokines by the drug that blocks them; clinics teach the table backwards.

left.title: Interleukin pairs
points: IL 2: T cell growth, Treg survival

steps.tx: **Interferons** divide by receptor and era: type I (alpha, beta) antiviral innate (previous lesson), type II gamma the macrophage activator whose recombinant form serves chronic granulomatous disease and osteopetrosis niches, and type III lambda mucosal. Their flu like toxicity is cytokine physiology experienced from the patient side.
steps.say: Gamma activates macrophages, alpha warns against viruses; patients feel both as flu.

right.title: Type I therapeutics
points: Antiviral era mostly inherited by direct agents

steps.tx: **Cytokine storm** is network failure at scale: sepsis, haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (ferritin, cytopenias, hemophagocytosis, IL 18 and interferon gamma signatures), CAR T cytokine release, and macrophage activation in rheumatic disease, treated increasingly by named blockade (IL 1, IL 6, JAK) beside source control. The network metaphor becomes therapy when single nodes are druggable.
steps.say: Storms are networks, but single blocked nodes (IL 6, IL 1, JAK) can calm them.

left.title: Storm portraits
points: HLH: interferon gamma axis, ferritin extreme
COVID era: IL 6 and JAK lessons

right.title: Storm answers
points: Steroids broad and blunt, still used
